timeline_events.title: 确定申请方向与目标院校
timeline_events.title_en: Define application direction and target universities
timeline_events.description: 根据本科专业、GPA、雅思成绩，确定申请院校层次（冲刺/主申/保底）。建议参考 QS 排名、课程设置和地理位置综合考量。
timeline_events.description_en: Based on your major, GPA, and IELTS score, determine your application tier (reach/match/safety). Consider QS ranking, course content, and location.

timeline_events.title: 开始准备雅思（IELTS）
timeline_events.description: 雅思有效期为 2 年，9 月入学的同学最晚需在次年 7 月前考出成绩。理工科通常要求 6.5（6.0），部分院校接受 6.0（5.5）。建议提前 6 个月开始系统备考。
timeline_events.description_en: IELTS validity is 2 years. For September intake, aim to complete IELTS by July. Engineering programmes typically require 6.5 (6.0). Start preparing 6 months in advance.

timeline_events.title: 准备申请材料
timeline_events.description: 整理本科成绩单、在读证明、个人陈述（PS）、推荐信、简历等申请材料。PS 建议提前 1-2 个月开始撰写并反复修改。
timeline_events.description_en: Organize transcripts, degree certificates, personal statement (PS), reference letters, and CV. Start drafting your PS 1-2 months in advance.

timeline_events.title: 准备资金证明（28天规则）
timeline_events.description: UKVI 要求资金在银行存满 28 个连续自然日。伦敦地区需约 £13,761/月，外伦敦约 £10,539/月（9个月）。建议尽早将资金存入账户。
timeline_events.description_en: UKVI requires funds to be held in your account for 28 consecutive days. London: ~£13,761/month; outside London: ~£10,539/month (9 months).

timeline_events.title: 提交申请
timeline_events.description: 通过学校官网或 UCAS 提交申请。英国硕士多为滚动录取（Rolling），建议尽早提交以提高录取概率。注意部分学校有明确的申请截止日期。
timeline_events.description_en: Submit applications via university portals or UCAS. Most UK Master's programmes use rolling admission — apply early. Check for specific deadlines.

timeline_events.title: 准备雅思正式考试
timeline_events.description: 如之前未取得满意成绩，需在此阶段完成雅思正式考试。雅思成绩通常 13 个工作日内出分，建议留出足够缓冲时间。
timeline_events.description_en: Take the official IELTS exam if not yet satisfied with your score. Results typically take 13 business days. Allow buffer time.

timeline_events.title: 等待offer并确认
timeline_events.description: 收到 offer 后仔细核对条件（通常为雅思成绩和最终 GPA）。在 deadline 前接受 offer 并缴纳押金（通常 £2,000–£5,000）。
timeline_events.description_en: Check offer conditions (usually IELTS and final GPA). Accept your offer and pay the deposit (typically £2,000–£5,000) before the deadline.

timeline_events.title: 申请CAS（Confirmation of Acceptance for Studies）
timeline_events.description: 在满足所有 offer 条件后，向学校申请 CAS。CAS 有效期为签发后 6 个月，只能使用一次。通常需在课程开始前 3-4 个月申请。
timeline_events.description_en: After meeting all offer conditions, request your CAS from the university. CAS is valid for 6 months and can only be used once. Typically requested 3-4 months before course start.

timeline_events.title: 肺结核检测（TB Test）
timeline_events.description: 部分国家（如中国）的学生需前往指定机构完成肺结核检测。检测报告有效期 6 个月，需在递签前完成。
timeline_events.description_en: Students from certain countries (including China) must take a TB test at an approved clinic. Results are valid for 6 months.

timeline_events.title: 申请学生签证
timeline_events.description: 持 CAS 申请 Student Visa（学生签证）。签证费约 £524，移民健康附加费（IHS）约 £776/年。可提前 6 个月申请，建议 7 月尽早申请避开 8 月高峰。
timeline_events.description_en: Apply for Student Visa with your CAS. Visa fee ~£524, IHS ~£776/year. Apply up to 6 months before course start. Apply early in July to avoid August rush.

timeline_events.title: 采集生物信息（Biometrics）
timeline_events.description: 在 UK Visa Application Centre 预约生物信息采集（指纹和照片）。标准处理时间约 15 个工作日（3 周），可加急（5 工作日/+£500 或 1-2 工作日/+£1,000）。
timeline_events.description_en: Book a biometrics appointment at a UK Visa Application Centre. Standard processing: 15 working days. Priority: 5 days (+£500). Super Priority: 1-2 days (+£1,000).

timeline_events.title: 等待签证结果
timeline_events.description: 等待签证决定。标准处理约 3 周，高峰期（8月）可能延长至 4-5 周。获批后会收到 eVisa 通知，需在 UKVI 账户中确认。
timeline_events.description_en: Wait for visa decision. Standard processing ~3 weeks, may extend to 4-5 weeks during August peak. Approved visas result in an eVisa notification via your UKVI account.

timeline_events.title: 申请大学宿舍/租房
timeline_events.title_en: Apply for university accommodation or private rent
timeline_events.description: 大学宿舍通常需提前申请，名额有限。若选择校外租房，建议通过正规平台（如 Rightmove、Zoopla、Student.com）查找，注意合同条款和押金保护。
timeline_events.description_en: University halls fill up quickly — apply early. For private rentals, use reputable platforms (Rightmove, Zoopla, Student.com). Check contracts and deposit protection.

timeline_events.title: 缴纳学费押金/学费
timeline_events.description: 部分学校在 offer 阶段已缴押金，部分学校需在开学前缴清第一学期或全年学费。使用学校指定支付方式（Flywire/Western Union/银行转账），注意手续费和汇率。
timeline_events.description_en: Some universities require deposit at offer stage, others before enrolment. Use university-approved payment methods (Flywire, Western Union, bank transfer). Be aware of fees and exchange rates.

timeline_events.title: 购买机票
timeline_events.description: 建议在签证获批后再购买机票（除非可退改）。航班选择方面，考虑直飞/转机、行李额度、到达时间。提前 1-2 个月预订通常价格较优。
timeline_events.description_en: Book flights after visa approval (unless fully refundable). Consider direct vs. connecting flights, baggage allowance, and arrival time. Book 1-2 months ahead for better prices.

timeline_events.title: 预约接机服务
timeline_events.description: 部分大学和宿舍提供免费或付费接机服务。也可提前预约出租车或使用 Uber。确认接机时间和集合地点，提前告知航班信息。
timeline_events.description_en: Many universities and accommodation providers offer free or paid airport transfers. Pre-book taxis or Uber. Confirm pickup time, location, and provide flight details.

timeline_events.title: 整理行李与出发前清单
timeline_events.description: 整理重要文件（护照、签证、CAS、肺结核证明、学历证明、雅思成绩单、住宿确认函）。准备日常生活用品，注意航空公司行李限额（通常 23-32kg）。
timeline_events.description_en: Organize key documents (passport, visa, CAS, TB certificate, degree documents, IELTS, accommodation confirmation). Pack essentials, noting airline weight limits (usually 23-32kg).

timeline_events.title: 抵达英国
timeline_events.description: 可在课程开始前 1 个月内入境英国。建议提前 2-3 天到达以安顿和倒时差。抵达后第一时间确认住宿入住、网络开通等事宜。
timeline_events.description_en: You can arrive up to 1 month before your course starts. Arrive 2-3 days early to settle in and adjust to the timezone.

timeline_events.title: 大学注册与入学报到
timeline_events.description: 完成线上注册和线下报到（通常需出示护照、签证、CAS、肺结核证明）。参加新生周（Welcome Week）活动，熟悉校园和同学。
timeline_events.description_en: Complete online registration and in-person enrollment (passport, visa, CAS, TB certificate required). Attend Welcome Week to familiarise yourself with campus.

timeline_events.title: 银行开户
timeline_events.description: 到校后尽快开设英国银行账户（如 Barclays、HSBC、Monzo、Starling）。通常需要护照、签证、地址证明（宿舍合同或租赁协议）。
timeline_events.description_en: Open a UK bank account as soon as possible (Barclays, HSBC, Monzo, Starling). Requirements: passport, visa, proof of address (accommodation contract or tenancy agreement).

timeline_events.title: GP（全科医生）注册
timeline_events.description: 抵达后尽快注册 NHS 全科医生。缴纳 IHS 后可在 NHS 系统享受医疗服务。需要准备护照、签证、地址证明。
timeline_events.description_en: Register with an NHS GP upon arrival. Having paid the IHS entitles you to NHS healthcare. Prepare passport, visa, and proof of address.

timeline_events.title: 熟悉校园与城市
timeline_events.description: 参加新生周活动，熟悉校园设施、图书馆、教学楼位置。了解城市交通（公交、地铁、自行车）、超市位置、银行网点等生活信息。
timeline_events.description_en: Attend Welcome Week events. Familiarise yourself with campus facilities, libraries, and buildings. Learn about local transport, supermarkets, and banks.
